notes: Doepfer A-100BS2 in a 3-row (9U, P9-style) suitcase. Rows 0 and 1 are full 84 HP rows exactly as Doepfer's BS2 module list; row 2 is two ~42 HP blank panels (the brief's 'lower row partly empty' is this blank row). All widths match Doepfer's published widths; positions come from per-row fits of x = L + s*hp at the top and bottom panel edges (keystone: scale shrinks downward, 33.7 -> 31.5 px/HP). Implied right ends sit at ~83.6-83.8 HP, so the last ~0.3 HP of each row is under the frame; no empty rail detected. 11 of 22 modules are off-catalog (open_set) because the catalog has only 51 Doepfer rows. Three matches rely on Doepfer renumbering rather than an exact read: n12 panel 'A-118' -> catalog 'A-118-1'; n21/n22 panel 'A-140-1' -> catalog 'A-140'. Two near-miss names to watch as hard negatives: A-160-1 (here) vs catalog A-160-2; A-138a/b (here) vs catalog A-138m. Commons description only says 'Doepfer A-100BS2 linked to a Linnstrument'.
